name: Mainichikoh Natural — Sakura & Sandalwood (毎日香ナチュラル さくら)
description: The Natural line's second scent, added in spring 2019: cherry blossom over sandalwood, described by the maker as a fruity floral that opens softly. Same low-smoke, low-residue formula as the bodhi and sandalwood box. Not yet reviewed on the shelf; listed so the family sits together.
dek: Nippon Kodo · low-smoke stick incense · ¥968 bulk box · sibling of the shelf pick
